description_en: Retrieves the URL of a recording file by file name from the storage card of a local network video recorder (NVR) or IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口，获取本地NVR设备或IPC设备的存储卡中，指定录像文件名的录像文件URL
name: QueryDeviceVodUrl

parameters.help_en:
The recording file name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69584.html operation provided by IoT Platform to query the file name. For request parameter examples, see Supplementary description of request parameters below.

The recording file name cannot exceed 180 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
录像文件名。可调用物联网平台提供的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69584.html查询，其中请求参数示例，请参见下方的**请求参数补充说明**。

录像文件名长度不得超过180个字符
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:
rtmp: RTMP protocol.
flv: HTTP-FLV protocol.
hls: HLS protocol.
For more information about the limits on the HLS protocol, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208584.html
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型：
rtmp：RTMP协议。
flv：HTTP-FLV协议。
hls：HLS协议。
HLS协议使用限制详细内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208584.html
parameters.name: scheme

parameters.help_en: The offset from the recording start time BeginTime, in seconds. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 相对于录像开始时间BeginTime的偏移量，单位为秒，默认值为0
parameters.name: seek_time

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no<props="intl"><ph> Overview page or</ph></props> ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to view information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the URL. Valid values:
true: Encrypted.
false (default): Not encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
是否加密：
true：加密
false（默认）：不加密
parameters.name: should_encrypt

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId serves as the unique identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the URL. Valid values: 10 to 14400. Unit: seconds. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: URL有效期，取值范围为10~14400，单位为秒。默认值为10
parameters.name: url_valid_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the playback URL can be used an unlimited number of times. Valid values:
true: The URL can be used an unlimited number of times within 10 seconds.
false (default): The URL can be used only once
parameters.help_zh:
播放地址是否可以无限次使用：
true：10秒内可无限次使用。
false（默认）：仅可使用一次
parameters.name: play_un_limited

parameters.help_en: The encryption type. Currently, only I-frame encryption is supported. Set the value to 0
parameters.help_zh: 加密类型。目前仅支持I帧加密，取值为0
parameters.name: encrypt_type

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

DecryptKey.description_en:
The decryption key.
A decryption key is generated when the ShouldEncrypt parameter is set to true
DecryptKey.description_zh:
解密密钥。
设置ShouldEncrypt参数为true时，生成解密密钥

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
